verdict.rationale: Recruitee documents webhooks that send HTTP POST requests to a configured URL whenever chosen events occur, with test requests, 30-day request logs, and role-based permission to manage them. That gives event-triggered automation, but the actual actions must be built in an external system. The only hint of native in-product rules is a bare 'AI & Automation' feature heading. Missing for 10: a documented native rule/trigger builder (e.g. stage-based automated actions), conditions or filters on triggers, a catalog of in-product actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
